initial_plan.h1_exception: independent strong h1_multi_bound baseline; its initial plan may differ
initial_plan.finish: same integer-second refinement for all; included in solve budget

budget.calibration_method: original H+300 full, three complete solves per instance/environment
budget.overtime_policy: keep latest legal fallback but mark timeout; cannot pass acceptance
budget.finish_reserve: max(0.05, 1.25 * median(three original H+ calibration finish-stage times)); search deadline=B-reserve; finish still inside B

acceptance.aggregation: equal catalog weight; mean across the three fixed seeds inside catalog, paired bootstrap over catalogs
acceptance.comparator: per catalog and seed maximum S of all completed validated non-neural methods within budget; conservative preregistered clarification
acceptance.missing_or_failed_controls: retain and fail completeness; do not drop or claim pass
acceptance.coverage: each completed neural plan C >= same initial C and original hplus_extended C

static_training.normalizer: fit separately on each selected train subset; scene-equal moments; hash stored
static_training.scene_sampling: shuffle scene order each cycle; 16 batches per scene; candidate-uniform sampling with replacement within scene; equal steps per scene
static_training.selection: all validation scene-mean natural-distribution average precision; planner pilot gate remains required
static_training.positive_weight: (1 - mean_scene_positive_rate) / mean_scene_positive_rate; selected train subset only

dynamic_training.label: delta C/S/Q against repair of unchanged parent with identical attempt and time budget
dynamic_training.loss: within-parent-state pairwise logistic ranking; completed noncensored pairs only
dynamic_training.mixture_rounding: 8 states: 4 rule, 2 random, 2 trained; before ranker 4 rule, 4 random
dynamic_training.censored_policy: persist timeouts with null gain; never convert timeout to zero training label
dynamic_training.sampling: catalog-uniform then parent-state-uniform; all non-tied delta_Q pairs in state
dynamic_training.pretrained_static_normalizer: retain stage A coordinate system; dynamic normalizer train-only
dynamic_training.random_init_normalizer: fit static and dynamic normalizers on train dynamic samples only

search.accept: C nondecreasing and Q strictly increasing after complete operation
search.global_target_history: all stations, entire horizon; previous end to next start >=48h
search.rollback: immutable parent or verified transaction; deadline returns last legal schedule

stop_conditions.calibration_timeout_fraction: report actual 100-operation rate; substantial timeouts require review before expansion (no invented numeric threshold)
stop_conditions.pilot: 40 catalogs; fixed 12 validation scenes; stop if mean S gain vs rule <=0 or inference overhead removes gain
stop_conditions.search: stop expansion when same-budget new search loses to extended original local search
stop_conditions.pilot_group_reporting: report 6 core and 6 stress cases separately; registered pilot aggregate remains equal-weight all 12

report.pareto: actual valid candidates, Q maximum and solve_s minimum, within instance/seed/environment

runtime_freeze.test_use: one frozen campaign; retain all attempts; no reselection from test

local_scope: bounded CPU smoke only; no full geometry rebuild or long laptop training
cloud_authorization: requires user-provided instance and explicit finite paid budget; no automatic purchase or Famou cloud experiment
